sources.title: Free AI 3D Model Generator: High Quality AI 3D Models
sources.snippet: An AI 3D Model Generator That Goes From Ideas to Assets Fast Manex3D turns reference images and plain-text prompts into fully textured, production-ready 3D models in under a minute. Generate clean geometry, high-quality materials, and game-ready topology, then export to GLB, OBJ, STL or PLY, and drop straight into your 3D model editor or game engine!

sources.snippet: Welcome to the Waveshare ESP32-AIChats repository! This project aims to share a solution for connecting the ESP32 to cloud-based large models, enabling voice interaction and conversational AI. The purpose of this repository is to provide resources and insights related to ESP32-based voice interfaces, integrating with powerful cloud models to offer real-time communication and AI capabilities ...
